purpose: analysis-only feature-only building-component sensitivity; no candidate upload or accuracy claim
allowed_inputs: provided Overture buildings bbox, geometry, subtype, has_parts, num_floors, height
provided ACS tract GEOID/geometry for spatial assignment
existing provided-feature overture_buildings count solely for count reconciliation
forbidden_inputs: sample score placeholders or hidden labels
MS, USFS, CarbonPlan, or other reference footprint counts or geometries
external imagery or external footprint data
ACS housing-unit counts as a denominator or floor

spatial_assignment.building_assignment: center of the provided building bbox, matching the existing Overture count aggregation; boundary ties resolve to lowest official tract index
spatial_assignment.area_projection: provided Overture building WKB geometries transformed from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:5070; area in square metres

features: median_area = clip(log1p(median valid projected footprint area_m2) / log1p(500 m2), 0, 1); zero if no valid geometry
verticality = mean over assigned buildings of clip(max(num_floors when positive else height_m/3 when positive else 0) / 4, 0, 1)
subtype_support = share of assigned buildings with non-null non-empty subtype
parts_support = share of assigned buildings with has_parts=true
morphology_support.support_formula: arithmetic mean of the six listed bounded features; all weights frozen equally

component_rule.baseline: 0.01 if provided Overture building count > 0; otherwise undefined with numeric placeholder 0 and building_defined=0
component_rule.morphology_candidate: 0.01 + beta * (1 - morphology_support) when building_defined=1; otherwise numeric placeholder 0 and building_defined=0
component_rule.coefficient_rationale: fixed conservative perturbation envelope around the existing 0.01 near-zero baseline; no target or leaderboard fit

summaries: percent changed versus baseline for each beta
acceptance: all component values finite and in [0,0.1]
